method.channels: CH 1–8, rotated in visible bank order; every navigation ends with WING EQ open
method.stripClick: Actual .strip-label.click(); if the application returns to Channel, click the real EQ tab and report that extra action separately
method.macro: Eight preassigned macros M9–M16, one editor action per CH1–8; existing runMacro execution; no definition changes, audio, OSC, or wait actions
method.gesture: 120 successive setParam 1g updates (-6.0 to +5.9 dB), or updateStrip fader updates (-30.0 to -18.1 dB); one begin/endGesture pair; CH 1 EQ stays open
method.timing: Per-operation latency includes synchronous app work, microtasks and explicitly drained non-meter RAF callbacks; final project flush timed separately and included in sample total. Initialization, warmup and mutation classification excluded
method.persistence: Real JSDOM Storage. Rapid operations without artificial dwell; final flush ensures pending save is included. These counts do not model saves between slow human clicks.
method.instrumentation: In-memory counters inserted at named function entries; production source files remain unchanged. Subscriber facade counts actual registered callbacks; createElement and replaceChildren counters plus MutationObserver records. Same probes used for both versions.
method.profile: Separate extra pass under Node Inspector 1 ms sampling; profile timings are excluded from comparison medians
method.excluded: CSS layout, paint/compositing, meter animation, native macOS/Electron scheduling, UDP/TCP and hardware. This is a CPU/DOM diagnostic, not Mac responsiveness, FPS or audio latency.
method.isolation: Each sample runs in a fresh Node child process; source snapshots are passed from the parent. Four navigation or eight parameter warmup operations are excluded. No earlier JSDOM window is retained.
method.snapshot: All measured modules read once in the parent before samples; original SHA256 retained, with end-of-run source-change check
